title: Trump arrives in Manila for Asean-US special summit, Marcos meeting

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump arrived in Manila on Tuesday afternoon for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit and bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. The Air Force One aircraft carrying Trump landed at the Balagbag Ramp Area (Ages Ramp) at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Pasay City
